The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: NIT Srinagar Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 18 vacancies are available – 1 for Electrical Engineering, 2 for Metallurgical & Materials Engineering, 3 for Electronics and Communication Engineering, 5 for Information Technology, 6 for Computer Science & Engineering, and 1 for Humanities, Social Sciences & Management (English).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Srinagar Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Srinagar Temporary Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 10-08-2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Temporary Faculty at NIT Srinagar?
faq.answer: There are a total of 18 vacancies for the Temporary Faculty positions announced by NIT Srinagar in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for these positions?
faq.answer: The application for these Temporary Faculty positions at NIT Srinagar must be submitted via Email.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Temporary Faculty role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Temporary Faculty positions will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 65,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the minimum educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualifications include B.E./B.Tech and M.E./M.Tech with Ph.D for engineering disciplines, and Bachelors/Masters in English with Ph.D for the Humanities, Social Sciences & Management post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for NIT Srinagar Temporary Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. Which departments have vacancies for Temporary Faculty?
faq.answer: Vacancies are available in Electrical Engineering, Metallurgical & Materials Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science & Engineering, and Humanities, Social Sciences & Management (English).

faq.question: Q8. Where is NIT Srinagar located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Srinagar is located in Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir, with the pincode 190006.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions for Temporary Faculty are on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
